articles.summary: HOUSTON, Jan. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Evolution Petroleum Corporation (NYSE American: EPM) ("Evolution" or the "Company") today announced that it plans to release its fiscal second quarter 2026 financial and operating results on Tuesday, February 10, 2026, after the market closes.
articles.title: Evolution Petroleum Schedules Fiscal Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
